intro: I lead a forward-deployed engineering team at Microsoft Frontier Company and advise Fortune 500 executives on agentic AI. Patent co-inventor, published author, adjunct computer-science professor, and Army National Guard cyber officer.

principles.title: Software Design
principles.body: Small pieces with clear names and clear boundaries. Code is read far more often than it is written, so I design for the next engineer who has to change it.

principles.title: Software Architecture
principles.body: Architecture is a socio-technical craft: systems mirror the teams that build them, and the order of decisions matters as much as the decisions themselves.

principles.title: Agentic Software Development
principles.body: The model is only part of the system. I engineer the loop and the harness around it: the context, tools, guardrails and evals that let agents plan, act and check their own work.

principles.title: Software Development Lifecycle
principles.body: Quality is built in, not inspected in. Automated tests, security scanning and fast reviews let a team build fast without breaking things later.

principles.title: Engineering Leadership
principles.body: Clear intent, real ownership, and the trust to decide without waiting on me. Lessons from leading engineers and commanding Soldiers.
